remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. O'Keeffe and her sister, Claudia, vacationed in Colorado in August 1917. See cat. nos. 213–25. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. Drawing dominates the middle and upper half of the paper. A small mountain rests between two larger mountains, the largest of which is located on the left side of the paper.
title: Untitled (Colorado Landscape)
